scope: Build and restore the real shared CLI/AOT toolset, then run complete verify_crate_packages.sh audits with local or restored tools. Workflow dependency changes were not part of this experiment.

cases.name: producer-cli-baseline
cases.kind: compile CLI, including initially cold profile dependencies

cases.name: producer-toolset
cases.kind: add AOT generator and package both executables after the CLI compile

cases.name: package-baseline-1
cases.kind: first complete audit after compiler source-layout and script changes

cases.name: package-baseline-2
cases.kind: warm complete audit with local dev tools

cases.name: package-toolset-1
cases.kind: complete audit with restored ci-cli tools and implicit tool builds forbidden

cases.name: package-toolset-2
cases.kind: repeat complete audit with restored tools

controls.changed_generator_under_original_manifes: refused even after outer checksums were recomputed
controls.pipeline_missing_or_unsuccessful_produce: refused for both package verification and release rehearsal
controls.fresh_cargo_home: Real frozen packaging refused missing sha2-const, then passed after the owning locked host-dependency fetch without compilation

decision: Publish the generator alongside the shared CLI and let package verification and the release rehearsal consume the verified pair. Keep all archive checks and qualification gates.
limitations: The producer's initial CLI compile and its incremental generator addition have different warmth; their totals are not alternative full-producer timings.
The first local-tool package audit includes transition compilation and is excluded from the warm comparison.
Local dev tools and restored ci-cli tools have different optimization profiles. The comparison measures the actual proposed handoff, not only executable transfer.

These sequential constrained-host samples are not GitHub merge-group measurements. Artifact transfer, delayed job setup, and the new dependency on the CLI producer still require real CI qualification.
The cache refresh writer retains its existing combined local build fallback; this experiment changes the consuming CI jobs.

CI exposed the package job's previously implicit registry bootstrap. Its new explicit locked host fetch is covered by a real cold-cache refusal/recovery control; its hosted network cost is not included in the warm audit samples.
